record.question: Alan has been feeling sick _________ he ate some fish last night.
record.explanation: Answer C: since. Since introduces the past starting point of the ongoing illness (C). Independent check: “Since” introduces the past event that marks the start of the period during which he has felt sick. Reference: https://dictionary.cambridge.org/grammar/british-grammar/since.
